name: Entropy Source & DRBG Assessment
description: Covers assessment of random bit generation according to NIST SP 800-90A/B/C and BSI AIS 20/31. Includes entropy estimation and health test evaluation for entropy sources, DRBG mechanism selection, instantiation, seeding and reseeding configuration, RBG construction review, and preparation of entropy assessment evidence for validation. Hardware TRNG design and noise-source physics evaluation belongs to HWSEC-CRYPTO-RNG.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to entropy source or DRBG assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands random bit generation architecture and the governing standards
evidence: Can explain the roles of entropy sources, conditioning and DRBGs in an RBG construction
Can describe the DRBG mechanisms of SP 800-90A and their security strength
Aware of the scope of SP 800-90B, SP 800-90C and the AIS 20/31 functionality classes

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Assists with entropy and DRBG assessment under supervision
evidence: Collects raw and restart noise samples according to the test procedure
Runs SP 800-90B entropy estimation tooling and records the results
Reviews DRBG configuration (mechanism, seed length, reseed interval) against a checklist with guidance
Documents observations in the lab's records

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses entropy sources and DRBG configurations
evidence: Interprets entropy estimates and justifies the claimed min-entropy rate, including IID versus non-IID treatment
Evaluates continuous and start-up health tests for adequacy and correct failure handling
Reviews RBG construction against SP 800-90C and identifies seeding, reseeding or prediction resistance weaknesses
Prepares or reviews entropy assessment documentation for submission

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex RBG designs; reviews assessments; mentors team
evidence: Assesses entropy sources with complex conditioning chains or multiple noise sources
Evaluates RBG designs against AIS 20/31 classes and maps findings between BSI and NIST requirements
Technically reviews entropy assessment reports for statistical soundness and justification
Mentors analysts on entropy estimation and DRBG review

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognised authority on random bit generation; defines methodology; contributes to standards
evidence: Defines the lab's entropy and DRBG assessment methodology
Contributes to SP 800-90 series, AIS 20/31 or equivalent standards and guidance
Publishes research on entropy estimation or RBG weaknesses
Advises vendors and validation bodies on RBG design and assessment

assessment_methods.description: Review a vendor's entropy assessment report and DRBG configuration for a module, identifying unjustified entropy claims, inadequate health tests or seeding weaknesses
Given raw noise samples and a description of the entropy source, run SP 800-90B estimation, interpret the results and state a justified min-entropy claim
